description: Land Acquisition - Nabuluwa, Pannila, Kahawattha D/S Division, Rathnapura District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1882/45 of 03.10.2014, Maho D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including declarations of intent to acquire specific land parcels, descriptions of properties to be acquired, details about claimants, and notices about amendments to previous land acquisition notices. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land acquisitions, property descriptions, and related administrative procedures for public purpose.
